items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: He left here pretty early, I think, with Kepard and those fellows.

ctx.x: I noticed it when I first started, the first few times I blew it, I didn't know about the lip. I just popped my teeth on it. And I noticed the shape, but I thought it was all right. Yeah. And when I went to Mineta, well, of course, he'd tell me differently.
Do you remember George Bakke? Did you hear him? He left here pretty early, I think, with Kepard and those fellows. Do you remember hearing him, though, when you were a boy? No, I don't.

The only time I seen George Bakke or knew anything of George Bakke, of course, I had heard of him. The only time I seen George Bakke was about a couple of years before he died. When he came back? Yeah, after he came back here, I seen him working up, rap off the street and the bar up.
